limitations: Headless installed Chromium on cloud Linux, real Web Audio decoder, normal HTTP and trusted Playwright clicks.
Viewport emulation is not physical phone/native iOS testing.
Decoded PCM, source/gain instrumentation and UI checks do not prove subjective listening quality or independent spoken-text transcription.
Strict device fallback fixtures simulate installed voice lists; actual native voices are recorded separately.
